description: Curated, offline firmware-CVE reference dataset for the device (firmware) threat axis. Real CVE ids / CVSS / KEV status; affected version ranges curated to the lab firmware. This versioned data file replaces an in-code list so the CVE set is editable/refreshable without changing source. Stands in for the live NVD/KEV feed (VULN_PROVIDER=live, deferred to v2). Loaded by backend/services/cti/vuln_intel.py. Store ONLY the stored CveFinding fields (vendor_type and provider are derived).

findings.title: FortiOS SSL-VPN out-of-bounds write (pre-auth RCE)
findings.summary: Out-of-bounds write in FortiOS SSL-VPN allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute code via crafted requests. CISA KEV, known ransomware use.

findings.title: FortiOS fgfmd format-string RCE
findings.summary: Use of an externally-controlled format string in the FortiOS fgfmd daemon allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute code/commands. CISA KEV.

findings.title: PAN-OS GlobalProtect command injection (pre-auth RCE)
findings.summary: Command injection in the GlobalProtect feature of PAN-OS allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges. CISA KEV, exploited in the wild (Operation MidnightEclipse).

findings.title: PAN-OS management web interface authentication bypass
findings.summary: Authentication bypass in the PAN-OS management web interface lets a network attacker gain administrator privileges and run admin actions. CISA KEV.

findings.title: PAN-OS management web interface authentication bypass
findings.summary: Authentication bypass in the PAN-OS management web interface allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to invoke certain PHP scripts.
